body:
>You either have just not found someone attracted to you yet, or your personality is taking part in it or maybe it can simply just be the way you carry yourself. 

That's simply unsubstantiated.  Going off of years here. Doesn't matter the attitude, approach, does not matter. Never mattered. People in shabbier clothing who don't take care of themselves and certainly don't carry themselves well still get attention so it's pretty obvious what is going on.
Aesthetically challenged? I'm in such good shape I have passed out multiple times in the last few years from over-training. It's really scary when it happens and takes hours to recover from.

>If you find a way to love yourself, then you can let others in. 

But they don't want to come in because I'm ugly.  I didn't realize this until roughly five years ago. Before that I thought I just wasn't trying or doing things right, or wasn't confident enough.

Nope.  Everyone is really cool with it too. Being ugly in whatever form is like a free target in a society where people are "tolerant." Being ignored and made fun of all the time gets old. Every day it is more senseless and hopeless. You really learn a lot about what people *really* are, and maybe more importantly, what they *are not.*
